findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_instagram_recovery_path, check_review_removability, find_removal_route, list_services · Private data: check_instagram_recovery_path, check_knowledge_panel_readiness, find_removal_route · Public sink: check_instagram_recovery_path, find_removal_route · Destructive: check_review_removability, list_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_instagram_recovery_path, check_review_removability, find_removal_route, list_services · Private data: check_instagram_recovery_path, check_knowledge_panel_readiness, find_removal_route · Public sink: check_instagram_recovery_path, find_removal_route · Destructive: check_review_removability, list_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
